edges: Bobolink warns Martin to avoid conversation with the creatures in the country of conversation.
Martin becomes distracted and engages in conversation with a fish, which traps him in the country of conversation.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Tropical Storm Gert caused significant rainfall in Tamaulipas.
Princess Petulant waits for Martin to return with her toy but eventually becomes upset.
Tropical Storm Gert caused significant rainfall in San Luis Potosí.
Tropical Storm Gert made landfall south of Tampico.
A pine dwarf promises to bring Princess Petulant to the waterfall to show her the way to Martin.
Tropical Storm Gert formed in the Bay of Campeche.
One person died due to Tropical Storm Gert.
1,000 people were evacuated from low-lying residences and businesses near Naranjos Amatlán due to Tropical Storm Gert.
Tropical Storm Gert caused damage in Veracruz.
Tropical Storm Gert caused evacuations in Nuevo León.
